Elena Park: During Bexly POC — function_call create_order returns schema error on our validator: "TypeError: expected object, got string". Demo blocked. Anyone?
Mike Chen: Can you paste sanitized request + model output? Any streaming?
Elena Park: Not streaming. Request payload we sent (sanitized):
```
{"model":"redwood/gptx-1.4q","function_call":{"name":"create_order","arguments_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object"}}},"required":["order_id","items"]},"required":["order_id","items"]},"prompt":"..."}
```
Elena Park: Model response (sanitized):
```
{"name":"create_order","arguments":"{\"order_id\":\"ORD-900\",\"items\":\"[{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"X1\\\",\\\"qty\\\":1}]\"}"}
```
Elena Park: Notice arguments is a string (double-encoded JSON). Validator tries to parse it as object -> type error.
Samir Rao: That's a known case when wrapper code returns a stringified JSON in function_call. Which client lib are they using?
Elena Park: They used our JS SDK v0.9.2. Could be their callback serialized. Also they retried after a 429 and now report duplicate orders in their sandbox.
ops-bot: Rate limit exceeded for org bexly-co \u2014 429 at 1800123510 (burst applied).
Jules Park: Duplicate orders are because retries submit create_order twice when idempotency key missing. Recommend using idempotency-key header or client-side dedupe.
Mike Chen: Short-term: 1) unwrap arguments if string in SE adapter before validation, 2) ask customer to include idempotency-key on calls.
Elena Park: Applied quick patch in their integration: detect string arguments and JSON.parse before validating. Demo resumed.
Avery Cole: Bexly asked about Dedicated to avoid rate spikes during launch and wanted pricing. I'll prep 2-week eval proposal and include idempotency best-practices doc.
deploy-bot: Created ticket RT-4012 assigned to eng-runtime (fix: ensure function_call.arguments come back as native object when possible; add SDK guard).
Elena Park: Will follow up in CRM and add note to POC checklist: verify idempotency and function_call argument shapes.
sales-ops: Tacking pricing ask; looping in SE for follow-up.
Elena Park: Thanks 	6 demo back on track :white_check_mark:
